Metadata.title: CoSpace | Book coworking space by the hour
Metadata.description: Desks, meeting rooms and call cabins available by the hour in the city centre.

Common.serverError: Something broke on our side. Try again in a moment.
Common.notFoundTitle: We could not find this page
Common.notFoundDescription: The link may be broken, or the space is no longer available.

Footer.tagline: Coworking by the hour in the city centre.

Home.heroTitle: Book a desk at 10:00 and work until noon.
Home.heroBody: Desks, meeting rooms and soundproof cabins by the hour, between 7:00 and 21:00. No monthly fees, no contracts, no phone calls to check availability.
Home.scheduleCaption: Typical occupancy per hour over the last 30 days. The venue opens at 7:00 and closes at 21:00.
Home.typesTitle: Three ways to use the venue
Home.typesBody: Every kind of space has its own hourly rate and its own availability.
Home.deskBody: Individual seats, some with an external monitor or a height adjustable base.
Home.meetingRoomBody: Six to eight people, with video calls and a whiteboard.
Home.cabinBody: Soundproof, for calls and interviews with two or three people.
Home.howStepOneTitle: Pick the day and the hour
Home.howStepOneBody: Bookings run from 1 to 4 hours in a row and always start on the hour.
Home.howStepTwoBody: The server computes the price and stores it against your account.
Home.howStepThreeBody: You can cancel up to two hours before the booking starts.
Home.ctaBody: The catalog shows the real occupancy of every space, hour by hour.

Booking.title: Book this space
Booking.ruleHours: Between 1 and 4 hours in a row.

Booking.closedDay: The venue is closed at that hour.

Auth.loginDescription: Sign in to book spaces and manage your bookings.
Auth.registerDescription: It takes a minute. All you need is an email and a password.
Auth.passwordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers
Auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including one letter and one number.
Auth.turnstileRequired: Complete the security check before continuing.
Auth.turnstileError: The security check could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.

Dashboard.title: My bookings
Dashboard.description: Here you see your confirmed bookings, the ones that already happened and the cancelled ones.
Dashboard.emptyBody: Browse the catalog and book your first space by the hour.
Dashboard.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The record is kept and marked as cancelled.
Dashboard.cancelTooLate: This can no longer be cancelled: less than 2 hours remain before it starts.

Admin.title: Space administration
Admin.description: Create, edit and deactivate the spaces of the catalog. Spaces are never deleted.
Admin.codeHint: Uppercase letters, digits and dashes. For example MR-03.
Admin.imageHint: Path of an image inside the public folder.
Admin.reactivateHint: A deactivated space disappears from the public catalog.

Admin.cannotDeactivate: Cannot be deactivated: it still holds confirmed bookings ahead.
Admin.reservationsEmpty: There are no confirmed bookings ahead in the venue.
